newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mirvac buys Capital Property manager.
newsitem.headline: Mirvac buys Capital Property manager.

text.p: Property manager and developer Mirvac Ltd said on Thursday it had acquired the issued share capital of Capital Property Management Ltd (CPM), the manager of the Capital Property Trust.

Mirvac, which is about 25 percent owned by Lend Lease Corp Ltd, said the transaction is linked to today's institutional placement of a 17.7 percent interest in the Capital Property Trust representing part of the interest held by Terry Snow and his family, founders of Capital Property.
Mirvac said the acquisition of CPM brings property funds managed by the Mirvac group to over A$1.2 billion.
This is an increase of about A$530 million and comprises the Capital Property Trust portfolio of commercial property in Sydney and Canberra, currently managed by CPM, Mirvac said.

Mirvac managing director Robert Hamilton said the purchase of Capital would complement and broaden the range of property investment and funds management services offered by Mirvac, and would be earnings positive.
At 11.15 a.m. (0015 GMT), Mirvac units were unchanged at A$2.50, with Capital Property units unchanged from Wednesday's close of A$2.37, with 30.77 million units traded.
